https://www.myjoyonline.com/asikuma-inla.body: President John Mahama says the construction of the Asikuma Inland Port will help ease congestion at the Tema Port while creating jobs and opening up economic opportunities for residents of Asuogyaman. He says the facility, sponsored by LMI and financed by the International Finance Corporation (IFC), will serve as the southern terminal of the Volta Lake transport system when completed. Speaking at the Odwira Akyi Akwasidae Kese and the 15th anniversary of the enstoolment of Odeneho Kwafo Akoto III as Akwamuhene, President Mahama said the project will be supported by an extension of the railway line from Mpakadan to Asikuma. He explained that containers and other imports will be transported by rail from Tema to Asikuma, where they will be loaded onto barges and moved along the Volta River to Debre in the northern part of Ghana. According to the President, the arrangement will provide a more seamless transportation route for Ghana's northern neighbours in the Sahel, particularly Burkina Faso, allowing them to move goods without having to travel all the way to Tema. President Mahama said the development will not only reduce pressure on the Tema Port but also create opportunities for tourism and business through plans to establish a modern marina at Mpakadan. "All these investments are going to create jobs for the young people of Asuogyaman," he said. The President said the government will work closely with traditional authorities, the District Assembly, investors and local communities to ensure residents benefit directly from the development projects. He stressed that development must translate into tangible benefits for the communities where such investments are undertaken. "Development must not simply happen in our communities; it must happen for our communities," President Mahama stated. He said his vision is to see Akwamu preserve its traditional heritage while embracing modern economic opportunities, adding that prosperity must be shared across all regions and communities. Congratulating Odeneho Kwafo Akoto III on 15 years of leadership, the President wished him good health and wisdom, urging the current generation to build on the legacy of their forebears. "Our ancestors built a kingdom of influence. Our generation must build an economy of opportunity," he said
https://www.myjoyonline.com/asikuma-inla.title_zh: 阿西库马内河港将缓解特马港拥堵，并在阿苏奥吉亚曼创造就业机会
https://www.myjoyonline.com/asikuma-inla.body_zh: 约翰·马哈马总统表示，建设和阿苏库马内陆港将有助于缓解特马港的拥堵，同时创造就业机会，为阿苏奥亚曼居民开辟经济机会。他说，这座由LMI赞助、由国际金融公司（IFC）提供融资的设施建成后将作为沃尔特湖运输系统的南部终点站。马哈马总统在奥德瓦·阿基·阿夸西德·克塞传统庆典及奥德内霍·夸福·阿科托三世就任阿夸穆亨第15周年活动上表示，该项目将得到从姆帕卡丹至阿苏库马铁路延长线的支持。他解释说，集装箱和其他进口货物将从特马通过铁路运往阿苏库马，在那里装上驳船，沿沃尔特河运往加纳北部的德布雷。总统表示，这一安排将为加纳在萨赫勒地区的北方邻国，尤其是布基纳法索，提供更顺畅的运输路线，使这些国家无须长途运货至特马。马哈马总统表示，通过在姆帕卡丹建设现代化游艇码头的计划，该开发项目不仅将减轻特马港的压力，还将创造旅游和商业机会。他说：“所有这些投资都将为阿苏奥亚曼的年轻人创造就业机会。”总统表示，政府将与传统 authorities、区议会、投资者和当地社区密切合作，确保居民直接受益于这些开发项目。他强调，开发必须为开展此类投资的社区带来切实利益。马哈马总统表示：“发展不能仅仅发生在我们的社区；发展必须为了我们的社区而进行。”他说，希望看到阿夸穆在拥抱现代经济机遇的同时保护其传统遗产，并补充说，繁荣必须在所有地区和社区之间共享。在祝贺奥德内霍·夸福·阿科托三世领导阿夸穆15周年之际，总统祝愿他身体健康、智慧过人，并敦促当下一代在前人的基础上继续建设。他说：“我们的祖先建立了一个具有影响力的王国。我们这一代人必须建设一个充满机遇的经济体。”

https://www.inquirer.net/496558/comelec-.title_zh: Comelec再次否定有关2028年“不选举”说法
https://www.inquirer.net/496558/comelec-.body_zh: 在周日接受 dzBB 采访时，菲律宾选举委员会（Comelec）主席 George Erwin Garcia 被问及近期有关 2028 年不会举行选举的说法。他回答：“这绝不可能发生。《1987年宪法》规定 2028 年将举行选举。国会无法制定任何由总统签署、可用于修改《宪法》的法律。因此，我们向公众百分之百保证，2028 年一定会举行选举。”另请阅读：Hernandez 驳斥众议院正谋划“无选举”计划的说法。《1987年宪法》第七篇第四节规定，国家总统和副总统必须通过选举产生，任期六年，其任期从同一选举年份 6 月 30 日中午开始。此前，副总统 Sara Duterte 的发言人、律师 Paolo Panelo 在接受 Bilyonaryo News Channel 采访时表示，他曾与 Duterte 交谈，而她表示自己收到了一份关于 2028 年“无选举”计划的消息。众议院高级副议长 Ferdinand Hernandez 周四驳斥了众议院成员正制定推迟 2028 年选举计划的说法。Garcia 随后表示，总统和副选举不能与 Barangay 和 Sangguniang 选举相提并论，后者可以推迟，也可以缩短或延长任期。另请阅读：Comelec：不可能通过宪法修正案取消选举。他补充说：“总统和副总统的任期不能改变，因为我们没有逾期留任机制。他们的任期将于 2028 年 6 月 30 日中午结束。”Garcia 还介绍了 Comelec 为 2028 年选举所做的准备情况，称候选人资格证明书（COC）的提交时间定于 2027 年 9 月 20 日至 26 日。Garcia 早些时候表示，选举机构将比通常的 10 月第一周更早启动 COC 提交期，以便解决候选人资格争议，并立即开始印制正式选票。此外，他说，选举机构已经启动互联网投票系统和投票数据传输服务的招标程序。他补充称，自动计票机（ACM）的采购流程将于今年 12 月启动。您的订阅无法保存。请重试。您的订阅已成功。Garcia 还表示，选举机构将拨出 220 亿比索用于租赁 ACM，这与其在 2025 年中期选举中采用的机制相同。不过，他澄清称，上一届选举使用的 ACM 不会用于 2028 年选举，因为这些机器必须是全新的。/ms

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 计划于12月进行的投票引发对司法独立的担忧。执政的朝鲜民主党（DPK）周日列出弹劾最高法院首席大法官Cho Hee-dae的理由，并表示将在12月底前寻求国会投票，此举招致批评，认为可能损害司法独立。该党此前提出的其他理由包括法院对去年12月事件的回应。杨表示，执政党的做法已将其耐心推向极限。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: December vote plan draws concerns over judicial independence The ruling Democratic Party of Korea (DPK) laid out its grounds Sunday for impeaching Supreme Court Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae and said it would seek a National Assembly vote by the end of December, drawing criticism that the move could undermine judicial independence. At its first public briefing at the Assembly, the party’s impeachment task force pointed to the Supreme Court’s handling of President Lee Jae Myung’s election law case and Cho’s refusal to recommend a new candidate for a vacant Supreme Court seat. “We will do our utmost to finalize the impeachment motion as quickly as possible and bring it to a vote in the National Assembly before the end of December,” said Rep. Yang Bu-nam, who leads the task force. He did not give a date for filing the motion. Other grounds previously raised by the party include the court’s response to the Dec. 3, 2024, martial law declaration, allegations over court operating expenses and cash payments, and Cho’s refusal to testify before the Assembly. The DPK made pursuing Cho’s impeachment its official position Friday, a day after the Supreme Court sent former Prime Minister Han Duck-soo’s insurrection case back to the Seoul High Court. The court found insufficient evidence that Han intended to subvert the constitutional order when he urged then-President Yoon Suk Yeol to convene a Cabinet meeting before the latter declared martial law. It upheld findings that some of Han’s actions after the declaration amounted to participation in the insurrection. Yang said the ruling had pushed the party’s patience to its limit. “We will not cite the substance of the ruling as a ground for impeachment,” he said. The task force will review allegations of serious procedural flaws in how the court heard the case, he added. The main opposition People Power Party (PPP) has called the impeachment push political retaliation. “Did the DPK decide to pursue impeachment first and only then look for grounds?” PPP chief spokesperson Rep. Choi Bo-yun said in a statement Sunday, accusing the DPK of deciding to pursue impeachment before establishing its grounds. She urged the ruling party to drop the effort, warning that impeaching Cho over a ruling backed by a majority of Supreme Court justices would undermine judicial independence. “It was a very emotional decision,” said Lee Jong-hoon, a political commentator and adviser at Daeryun Law Firm, referring to the DPK’s decision to pursue impeachment after the ruling in Han’s case. Lee said DPK leader Kim Min-seok had previously urged the party to hold a parliamentary inquiry first and give impeachment more thought. “I thought the Supreme Court got it right,” Lee said of the court’s judgment on Han’s actions before martial law was declared. The dispute over the vacant seat turns on whether the president can require the chief justice to recommend a different candidate. Under the Constitution, the president appoints Supreme Court justices on the chief justice’s recommendation and with the Assembly’s consent. The DPK argues that Cho’s refusal to put forward another candidate infringed on the president’s appointment power. In a statement opposing the DPK’s earlier push for a parliamentary inquiry into Cho, Kim Hyun, standing representative of People Making Good Laws, argued that the Constitution imposes no duty on the chief justice to consult the president in advance or recommend a replacement candidate. “Raising the prospect of an inquiry and impeachment over the exercise of a constitutional power amounts to political pressure on the chief justice to exercise his nominating authority in line with the president’s wishes,” Kim said. The rift between Lee and Cho dates back to the 2025 presidential campaign. On May 1, 2025, just over a month before the election, the Supreme Court’s full bench overturned an appeals court ruling that had acquitted Lee, then the DPK candidate, of violating the Public Official Election Act. It sent the case back to the Seoul High Court. The DPK accused the court of rushing the case to influence the vote. The court said it had reviewed the case swiftly and thoroughly in keeping with election law. The two clashed again in August, when Cho recommended Sohn Bong-ki, a senior judge at the Daegu District Court, for a Supreme Court seat. The presidential office declined to submit the nomination to the Assembly for confirmation and asked Cho to put forward another candidate. Cho rejected the request in September, saying the presidential office had failed to give a specific reason or identify a constitutional basis for it. The presidential office countered that his interpretation infringed on the president’s appointment power
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 执政党列出弹劾首席大法官的理由
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 韩国计划12月投票引发对司法独立的担忧。执政的朝鲜民主劳动党（DPK）周日列举了弹劾大法院院长赵熙大的理由，并表示将争取在12月底前由国会表决，由此招致批评，认为此举可能削弱司法独立。该党在国会的首次公开简报会上，弹劾特查组指出大法院处理李在明总统选举法案件的做法，以及赵熙大拒绝为大法院一个空缺席位推荐新候选人的做法。领导特查组的杨江南议员说：“我们将尽最大努力，尽快完成弹劾动议，并在12月底前提交国会表决。”他没有说明提交动议的日期。该党此前提出的其他理由包括法院对2024年12月3日戒严令的应对、有关法院运营经费和现金支付的指控，以及赵熙大拒绝到国会作证。周五，DPK正式将追究赵熙大的弹劾作为本党立场；此前一天，大法院将前国务总理韩德洙的叛乱案发回首尔高等法院。法院认为，证据不足以证明韩德洙在敦促时任总统尹锡悦召开内阁会议、继而尹锡悦宣布戒严之际，意图颠覆宪政秩序。法院维持了认定韩德洙在戒严宣布后的部分行为构成参与叛乱的结论。杨江南称，这项裁决已把该党的耐心推向极限。他说：“我们不会把裁决的实体内容列为弹劾理由。”他补充说，特查组将审查法院审理该案时存在严重程序缺陷的指控。主要反对党国民力量党（PPP）称，推动弹劾是政治报复。PPP首席发言人崔보云议员周日在声明中说：“DPK是不是先决定追究弹劾，之后才寻找理由？”她指控DPK在尚未确立弹劾理由前便决定追究弹劾，并敦促执政党放弃此举，警告称，若因一项获得大法院多数法官支持的裁决而弹劾赵熙大，将削弱司法独立。政治评论员、大云律师事务所顾问李钟勋在谈及DPK因韩德洙案裁决而决定追究弹劾时说：“这是一个非常情绪化的决定。”李钟勋说，DPK领导人金民成此前曾敦促该党先举行国政调查，并对弹劾进行更多考虑。谈到法院对韩德洙在戒严宣布前行为的判决，李钟勋说：“我认为大法院判得没错。”双方围绕空缺席位的争端，焦点在于总统能否要求院长推荐另一名候选人。根据《宪法》，大法院法官由总统根据院长的推荐并经国会同意任命。DPK认为，赵熙大拒绝提出另一名候选人侵犯了总统的任命权。在反对DPK此前推动就赵熙大举行国政调查的声明中，制定良法常任代表金贤认为，《宪法》并未规定院长有义务事先与总统协商或推荐替代候选人。金贤说：“提出就行使宪法权力进行调查和弹劾的可能性，等同于对院长施加政治压力，要求其按照总统的意愿行使提名权。”李在明与赵熙大之间的裂痕可追溯至2025年总统竞选。2025年5月1日，即大选一个多月前，大法院全体法官推翻了上诉法院的一项裁决；该裁决曾判当时作为DPK候选人的李在明未违反《公职选举法》。大法院将案件发回首尔高等法院。DPK指控法院为影响投票而急于处理此案。法院表示，它依照选举法迅速而彻底地审查了此案。8月，双方再次发生冲突，当时赵熙大推荐大邱地方法院一名资深法官孙奉基出任大法院法官。总统办公室拒绝将该提名提交国会确认，并要求赵熙大提出另一名候选人。赵熙大于9月拒绝了这一要求，称总统办公室未给出具体理由，也未指出其宪法依据。总统办公室则反驳称，他的解释侵犯了总统的任命权

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/20.summary: Global recognition of kimchi spreads to 12 US jurisdictions, 6 other countries The Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs said Sunday that it held its first-ever Kimchi Global Vision Declaration ceremony in New York on Friday (local time) to mark the seventh annual Kimchi Day and promote kimchi in global markets.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/20.summary_zh: 泡菜在全球的认可度扩展至美国12个司法辖区和另外6个国家。韩国农业、食品和农村事务部周日表示，该部于当地时间周五在纽约首次举行泡菜全球愿景宣言仪式，以纪念第七届泡菜日并推动泡菜走向全球市场。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/20.body: Global recognition of kimchi spreads to 12 US jurisdictions, 6 other countries The Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs said Sunday that it held its first-ever Kimchi Global Vision Declaration ceremony in New York on Friday (local time) to mark the seventh annual Kimchi Day and promote kimchi in global markets. Kimchi Day was first designated on Nov. 22, 2020 to honor kimchi's cultural heritage, ingredients and health benefits. The event, held at the Korean Cultural Center New York, brought together about 100 participants, including New York State Assemblymember Ron Kim, Korean Consul General in New York Kim Sang-ho, chef Hooni Kim and local food industry representatives. As part of the ceremony, participants placed cards bearing five themes — fermentation science, health, globalization, tradition and Korea's role as kimchi's birthplace — into a traditional earthenware jar. YouTuber Maangchi demonstrated how to season salted cabbage before guests tried their hand at the kimchi-making process. “We will draw on scientific research and advances in fermentation and manufacturing to enhance kimchi's taste and quality, while developing products tailored to the food cultures of individual countries so that Korean kimchi becomes part of everyday meals around the world," Agriculture Minister Song Mi-ryung said in a video message. The ministry's efforts to introduce kimchi to a wider audience also included educational programs for younger people. On Wednesday, students at Democracy Prep Harlem High School, a public charter school in New York, screened videos they had made about kimchi, took a quiz and participated in kimchi-making. The session introduced them to "kimjang," the UNESCO-listed Korean tradition of making and sharing kimchi. The promotion continued on Friday with a local festival in New Jersey. The 2026 Korea Kimchi Festival was held at Pine Plaza in Palisades Park, where visitors made kimchi with chefs, watched K-pop dance performances and sampled Korean dishes. The festival also showcased winning entries from Korea's 2026 national kimchi competition. According to the ministry, California became the first U.S. state to recognize Kimchi Day in 2021. Since then, the observance has expanded to 12 U.S. jurisdictions and another 17 jurisdictions across six other countries outside Korea, including nationwide recognition in Argentina and a local observance in Paris' 15th arrondissement. The Royal Borough of Kingston upon Thames in the United Kingdom and British Columbia in Canada have also recognized Kimchi Day
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/20.title_zh: 韩国在纽约举行具有里程碑意义的泡菜日愿景宣言活动
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/20.body_zh: 泡菜日益获得全球认可，推广范围已扩大至美国12个辖区及另外6个国家。韩国农业食品农村事务部周日表示，该部于当地时间周五在纽约首次举行“泡菜全球愿景宣言”仪式，以纪念第七个“泡菜日”，并推动泡菜进入全球市场。“泡菜日”最初于2020年11月22日设立，旨在彰显泡菜的文化遗产、原料和健康益处。仪式在纽约韩国文化中心举行，约100人参加，包括纽约州众议员Ron Kim、驻纽约韩国总领事Kim Sang-ho、主厨Hooni Kim及当地食品行业代表。作为仪式的一部分，参与者将写有五个主题的卡片投入传统陶瓮中，五个主题分别是发酵科学、健康、全球化、传统，以及韩国作为泡菜发源地的作用。YouTuber Maangchi演示了如何给盐渍白菜调味，随后宾客亲身体验泡菜制作过程。韩国农业部长Song Mi-ryung在视频致辞中表示：“我们将借助科学研究以及发酵和制造技术进步，提升泡菜的味道与品质，同时开发适合各国饮食文化的产品，让韩国泡菜成为世界各地日常餐桌上的一部分。”该部为向更广泛受众推广泡菜所做的努力还包括面向青少年的教育项目。周三，纽约一所公立特许学校Democracy Prep Harlem High School的学生放映了自己制作的泡菜相关视频、参加知识测验，并参与泡菜制作。这项活动向学生介绍了列入联合国教科文组织名录的韩国泡菜制作与分享传统“kimjang”。推广活动于周五在新泽西州的一场当地节庆中继续。2026年韩国泡菜节在Palisades Park的Pine Plaza举行，访客与厨师一起制作泡菜、观看K-pop舞蹈表演并品尝韩国菜肴。节庆还展示了韩国2026年全国泡菜大赛的获奖作品。据该部介绍，加利福尼亚州于2021年成为美国首个承认“泡菜日”的州。此后，这一纪念日扩大至美国12个辖区，以及韩国以外6个国家的另外17个辖区，其中包括阿根廷全国范围的认可，以及巴黎第15区的地方性纪念活动。英国泰晤士河畔金斯顿皇家自治市和加拿大不列颠哥伦比亚省也承认了“泡菜日”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/20.summary_zh: 行业数据显示，由于对中国制造的特斯拉电动车需求上升，韩国1月至10月对华汽车贸易逆差升至历史新高。然而，在上述时期，韩国从中国进口汽车的金额同比增长79.2%，达到43.9亿美元，使贸易逆差创下42.3亿美元的历史纪录。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/20.body: South Korea's deficit in the car trade with China rose to a record high in the January-October period on rising demand for Tesla electric vehicles (EVs) made in China, industry data showed Sunday. South Korea exported $168.77 million worth of cars to China in the first 10 months of the year, down 34.9 percent from the same period last year, according to data from the Korea International Trade Association (KITA) and the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Resources. However, its imports of cars from China surged 79.2 percent on-year to $4.39 billion over the cited period, bringing the trade deficit to a record $4.23 billion. South Korea has recorded a deficit in the car trade with China every year since 2017, with the gap widening sharply from $466 million in 2022 to $943 million in 2023 and $1.73 billion in 2024. The widening deficit is largely attributed to strong sales of Tesla EVs manufactured at the U.S. automaker's Gigafactory in Shanghai. According to separate data from the Korea Automobile Importers & Distributors Association (KAIDA), 98,313 Tesla EVs were sold in South Korea in the January-October period, up 105 percent from a year earlier. China's BYD sold more than 20,000 cars in South Korea over the cited period. Additionally, Polestar has been selling China-made EVs in the country. The surge in imports of China-made vehicles helped China overtake Germany as South Korea's largest source of car imports in the first half of the year
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/20.title_zh: 受特斯拉电动汽车进口影响，韩国对华汽车贸易逆差创纪录
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/20.body_zh: 行业数据显示，由于中国产特斯拉电动车的需求上升，韩国在1月至10月期间对华汽车贸易逆差创历史新高。据韩国国际贸易协会（KITA）和贸易、工业与资源部数据，今年前10个月，韩国向中国出口价值1.6877亿美元的汽车，较去年同期下降34.9%。然而，同期韩国从中国进口汽车额同比增长79.2%，达到43.9亿美元，使贸易逆差达到创纪录的42.3亿美元。自2017年以来，韩国每年对华汽车贸易均出现逆差，逆差从2022年的4.66亿美元大幅扩大至2023年的9.43亿美元和2024年的17.3亿美元。逆差扩大主要归因于美国汽车制造商特斯拉上海超级工厂生产的电动车销量强劲。韩国汽车进口商与经销商协会（KAIDA）的另一项数据显示，1月至10月期间，韩国共销售98,313辆特斯拉电动车，较上年同期增长105%。同期，中国比亚迪在韩国售出超过20,000辆汽车。此外，Polestar也一直在韩国销售中国制造的电动车。中国制造汽车进口量激增，帮助中国在今年上半年超过德国，成为韩国最大的汽车进口来源地

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026112204.title: "中 국가안전부, 2년 전부터 첨단 칩 확보위해 비밀 작전"
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026112204.summary: (서울=연합뉴스) 송진원 기자 = 중국의 국가정보기관이 미국의 대중국 반도체 수출 통제를 우회하고 인공지능(AI) 기술의 핵심인 첨단 반도체 확보를 위한 비밀 작전을 최소 2년 전부터 추진해 온 것으로 전해졌다. 미국 뉴욕타임스(NYT)는 전·현직 해외 정보 당국자들을 인용해 중국 국가안전부 천이신 부장(장관)이 이 작전을 주도하며 자신이 직접 보고받는 실무팀을 구성했다고 21일(현지시간) 보도했다. 이 조직의 핵심 임무는 미국과 그 동맹국의 수출 통제로 중국이 확보하기 어려워진 첨단 반도체 입수를 지원하는 것이다.
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026112204.summary_zh: （首尔＝联合通讯社记者宋镇元）据报道，中国国家情报机构至少从两年前开始推进一项秘密行动，旨在规避美国对华半导体出口管制，并获取人工智能（AI）技术的核心——先进半导体。美国《纽约时报》（NYT）21日（当地时间）援引前现任海外情报官员的话报道称，中国国家安全部情报长（部长）田宜新主导了这项行动，并组建了直接向其汇报的工作团队。该组织的核心任务是为获取中国难以通过美国及其盟国出口管制取得的先进半导体提供支持。
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026112204.body: (서울=연합뉴스) 송진원 기자 = 중국의 국가정보기관이 미국의 대중국 반도체 수출 통제를 우회하고 인공지능(AI) 기술의 핵심인 첨단 반도체 확보를 위한 비밀 작전을 최소 2년 전부터 추진해 온 것으로 전해졌다. 미국 뉴욕타임스(NYT)는 전·현직 해외 정보 당국자들을 인용해 중국 국가안전부 천이신 부장(장관)이 이 작전을 주도하며 자신이 직접 보고받는 실무팀을 구성했다고 21일(현지시간) 보도했다. 이 조직의 핵심 임무는 미국과 그 동맹국의 수출 통제로 중국이 확보하기 어려워진 첨단 반도체 입수를 지원하는 것이다. 중국 기업들이 첨단 반도체를 확보해 중국으로 밀반입하도록 돕는 작업도 포함된다. 글로벌 반도체 산업과 공급망에 대한 정보도 수집하는 것으로 알려졌다. 천 부장은 올해 4월 공산당 간행물에 기고한 글에서 국가안전부의 새로운 임무를 공개적으로 강조했다. 그는 "봉쇄에 맞선 투쟁을 심화하고, AI 혁신, 산업 발전 및 응용을 포괄적으로 추진해야 한다"고 밝혔다. 이어 "핵심 기술의 '차보쯔'(卡脖子·목을 조르는 핵심 기술)' 문제를 해결하는 데 주력해야 한다"면서 "요청하거나 구매하거나 애원해서는 얻을 수 없는" 기술을 확보해야 한다고 강조했다. 이는 미국의 기술 수출통제를 단순한 경제·산업적 제약이 아니라 국가안보 차원의 대응 과제로 규정하고, 정보기관을 동원해 돌파구를 마련하겠다는 의지를 드러낸 것으로 풀이된다. 중국 안보 전문 컨설팅 회사 가노 글로벌의 알렉스 조스케는 "천 부장은 당 지도부와 소속 간부들에게 자신의 기관이 미국과의 AI 경쟁을 장기적이고 최우선 과제로 격상시키고 있음을 시사하고 있다"며 "그는 간부들에게 이 투쟁을 수행할 더 많은 방법을 찾으라고 지시하고 있는 것"이라고 평가했다. 천 부장은 2022년 말 국가안전부장에 임명된 이후 미국 등 서방의 첨단 기술 통제를 중국의 발전을 가로막는 '봉쇄'로 규정하며 대응을 강조해 왔다. 그는 지난해 공산당 간행물 기고문에서도 "강대국 간 기술 경쟁은 가장 치열하고 가장 격렬하며, 가장 중대한 접전 단계에 접어들었다"고 진단했다. 시 주석은 올해 1월 공산당 중앙정치국 회의에서 "우선 분야 핵심 기술 확보를 위한 노력을 강화하기 위해 비상한 조처를 해야 한다"며 "미래 산업 발전을 가로막고 있는 '차보쯔' 문제를 가능한 한 신속히 해결해야 한다"고 강조했다. 시 주석은 AI 발전에 필요한 컴퓨팅 성능 분야에서 미국과의 격차를 좁히기 위해 2023년 중앙 정부 차원에서 중앙과학기술위원회도 설립했다. 2022년 말 미국 상무부가 엔비디아의 첨단 칩이 중국에 직접 수출되는 걸 금지하기 시작한 지 얼마 지나지 않은 시점이다. 이 위원회는 중국 언론 보도에 거의 등장하지 않고 예산과 계획도 공개되지 않지만, 시 주석의 기술적 우위 확보 계획의 원동력이 됐다고 미 중앙정보국(CIA) 출신 중국 전문가 크리스토퍼 K. 존슨은 설명한다. 제보는 카카오톡 okjebo <저작권자(c) 연합뉴스, 무단 전재-재배포, AI 학습 및 활용 금지> 2026/11/22 18:28 송고 2026년11월22일 18시28분 송고
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026112204.title_zh: 中国国家安全部为获取先进芯片，两年前便开始秘密行动
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026112204.body_zh: （首尔=韩联社）记者宋真元=据报道，中国国家情报机构至少从两年前开始推行秘密行动，试图绕开美国针对中国的半导体出口管制，并获取人工智能（AI）技术的核心——先进半导体。美国《纽约时报》（NYT）21日（当地时间）援引前现任海外情报官员的话报道称，中国国家安全部部长陈仪新主导了这项行动，并组建了直接向其汇报的工作团队。该组织的核心任务是协助中国获取因美国及其盟国出口管制而难以取得的先进半导体，工作内容还包括帮助中国企业获取先进半导体并走私进入中国。据称，该组织还搜集有关全球半导体产业和供应链的信息。陈部长在今年4月刊载于共产党刊物的文章中，公开强调了国家安全部的新使命。他表示：“必须深化反封锁斗争，全面推进人工智能创新、产业发展和应用。”他还强调：“必须集中力量解决核心技术的‘卡脖子’问题”，确保掌握“靠请求、购买或乞求都无法获得”的技术。这意味着，美国的技术出口管制被界定为涉及国家安全的应对任务，而不只是经济或产业限制；相关机构将动用情报力量寻找突破口。中国国家安全问题咨询公司 Gano Global 的 Alex Joske 表示：“陈部长表明，其机构已将与美国的人工智能竞争提升为长期且最高优先级的任务。”他评价说：“他已指示官员寻找开展这场斗争的更多方式。”陈部长于2022年末获任国家安全部部长以来，一直强调将美国等西方对先进技术的管制视为阻碍中国发展的“封锁”，并着手应对。他在去年发表于共产党刊物的文章中诊断称：“大国之间的技术竞争已经进入最激烈、最激烈交锋、最重大碰撞的阶段。”习近平总书记在今年1月召开的中央政治局会议上强调：“为加强 efforts 以获取优先领域核心技术，必须采取非常措施。”他表示：“必须尽快解决阻碍未来产业发展的‘卡脖子’问题。”习近平还于2023年从中央政府层面设立了中央科技委员会，以缩小中国在人工智能发展所需计算性能方面与美国的差距。那是在美国商务部开始禁止英伟达先进芯片直接出口中国后不久，即2022年末。中国媒体报道几乎鲜有提及该委员会，其预算和计划也未公开，但美国中央情报局（CIA）出身的中国专家 Christopher K. Johnson 解释称，该委员会已成为习近平获取技术优势计划的推动力量。更多报道请登录 KakaoTalk 账号 okjebo <版权所有(c) 韩联社，未经许可禁止转载、再分发，禁止用于人工智能学习及使用>。2026年11月22日18:28发稿

https://leadership.ng/petrol-imports-fal.summary_zh: 监管机构2026年10月的事实清单显示，石油销售企业和尼日利亚国家石油有限公司的进口量在10月平均为每天1,500万升，而2025年10月为每天2,890万升。消费量以运往国内市场的卡车运输量计算，10月为每天4,650万升，低于一年前的每天5,670万升。进口量较9月每天1,020万升增长47%，消费量则较每天4,440万升增长5%。
https://leadership.ng/petrol-imports-fal.body: The regulator’s October 2026 fact sheet showed that imports by oil marketing companies and the Nigerian National Petroleum Company Limited averaged 15 million litres per day in October, against 28.9 million litres in October 2025. Also, consumption, measured by volumes trucked out to the domestic market, was 46.5 million litres daily, down from 56.7 million litres a year earlier. However, both figures rose on a monthly basis. Imports increased 47 per cent from 10.2 million litres daily in September, while consumption rose five per cent from 44.4 million litres. Total petrol receipts rose 21 per cent in October to 46.9 million litres daily from 38.7 million litres in September. Domestic refineries supplied 31.9 million litres, up 12 per cent. Local refineries supplied about 68 per cent of receipts, against about 37 per cent in October 2025, when they provided 17.1 million litres of 46 million litres received. Supply remained below the 50 million litres per day demand benchmark and the 13-month average of 50.2 million litres. Imports were below their 13-month average of 18.8 million litres daily and well under the 52.1 million litres recorded in November 2025, the highest in the period. The fact sheet showed that consumption was 93 per cent of the benchmark and below the 13-month mean of 51 million litres. It peaked at 63.7 million litres daily in December 2025. The Authority said higher crude receipts at domestic refineries and strong local petrol supply from the Dangote refinery meant most of the petrol consumed in October was refined in Nigeria. It said this reduced reliance on imports, eased pressure on foreign exchange and improved supply security. The Dangote refinery produced 48.51 million litres of petrol daily and ran at 103.73 per cent of its 650,000 barrels per day capacity, down 2.25 percentage points from September. Of its petrol output, 31.89 million litres went to the domestic market and 20.18 million litres, or 42 per cent of production, was exported. It drew 3.56 million litres daily from stock, and closing petrol stock fell 37 per cent to 229.9 million litres. Crude receipts at domestic refineries rose 19 per cent to 0.736 million barrels per day. Imported crude to Dangote grew 39 per cent to 118.4 thousand barrels per day, lowering the local crude share to 83.9 per cent from 86.1 per cent. The Port Harcourt, Warri and Kaduna refineries were not producing. Among modular refineries, Edo ran at 114.89 per cent of capacity, WalterSmith at 58.10 per cent, Aradel at 30.93 per cent and OPAC at 24.86 per cent. Duport was shut down. The modular refineries supplied 0.68 million litres of diesel daily, about 4.9 per cent of the 14 million litres benchmark. Petrol stock cover fell to 21.8 days from 23.9 days in September, 8.2 days below the required 30-day threshold. Inland depots held 19.53 days and vessels offshore 2.28 days. LPG cover was lower at 14.8 days. Diesel cover was 43.9 days and aviation fuel 75.8 days, both above the threshold. Diesel supply nearly doubled, rising 93 per cent to 16.8 million litres daily from 8.7 million litres. Imports rose to 6.1 million litres from 0.6 million litres, and domestic supply grew 32 per cent to 10.7 million litres. Supply moved above the 14 million litres benchmark and consumption of 15.5 million litres. Aviation fuel supply fell 36 per cent to 2.1 million litres daily, below consumption of 2.8 million litres and the 3 million litres benchmark. It was the lowest since July 2026. The Dangote refinery produced 26.44 million litres of aviation fuel daily, with exports taking 84 per cent. The Authority noted that the stock cover figure includes export-bound Dangote stock of 199.7 million litres. Cooking gas (LPG) supply rose 11 per cent to 5.2 kilotonnes per day, with domestic sources providing 4.8 kilotonnes. Consumption was 5.0 kilotonnes. Average petrol pump prices across eight monitored states rose about three per cent to N1,416.75 per litre, at the lower end of the indicative range of N1,413.71 to N1,447.00. The lowest actual prices were below the indicative minimum in all eight states. Cooking gas retailed from N1,208 per kilogramme in Lagos to N1,600 in Bauchi. Maximum retail prices exceeded the indicative price in all eight states monitored. Dated Brent crude averaged $124.77 per barrel, up seven per cent from September. Gasoline free-on-board cost fell eight per cent to $1,141.38 per metric tonne. The naira traded at N1,338.54 to the dollar, up one per cent. Total wholesale gas supply averaged 4.95 billion cubic feet per day (bcf/d) from January to October 2026. Domestic supply averaged 2.04 bcf/d, or 41.3 per cent, while supply to Nigeria LNG (NLNG) averaged 2.91 bcf/d, or 58.7 per cent. Supply peaked at 5.14 bcf/d in April and dipped to 4.723 bcf/d in July. In October it was 4.951 bcf/d, up 2.7 per cent on September, with domestic supply at 2.113 bcf/d and NLNG at 2.838 bcf/d. Gas-to-power rose 10 per cent to 0.571 bcf/d. LNG exports rose seven per cent to 52,721 metric tonnes per day, and pipeline exports via the West African Gas Pipeline rose 11 per cent to 0.149 bcf/d. Gas processing plants held 16.187 bcf/d of installed capacity across 47 plants and processed 8.401 bcf/d, an average utilisation of 51.90 per cent. Four of the seven major facilities ran above 80 per cent, led by Gbaran Ubie at 90.64 per cent. Three ran below 50 per cent, with OB/OB at 25.69 per cent and Utorogu at 29.41 per cent. Condensate production rose from 1.505 million barrels in January to 2.209 million barrels in October. The Obiafu-Obrikom-Oben (OB3) pipeline reached 100 per cent completion in October. The Ajaokuta-Kaduna-Kano pipeline stood at 84.27 per cent after being re-scoped to include additional ancillary works. The Odidi-Warri expansion was at 79.58 per cent, the Escravos-Odidi pipeline at 34.75 per cent and the Escravos-Lagos compressor project at 97.18 per cent. 监管机构2026年10月的事实清单显示，石油营销公司和尼日利亚国家石油公司有限公司的进口量在10月平均为每日1500万升，而2025年10月为每日2890万升。此外，以运往国内市场的卡车装载量衡量的消费量降至每日4650万升，一年前为每日5670万升。不过，这两项数字均较上月上升。进口量较9月每日1020万升增长47%，消费量则较9月每日4440万升增长5%。10月汽油接收总量较9月每日3870万升增长21%，达到每日4690万升。国内炼油厂供应量为3190万升，增长12%。本土炼油厂提供了约68%的接收量，而2025年10月约为37%，当时4600万升接收量中有1710万升来自本土炼油厂。供应量仍低于每日5000万升的需求基准和13个月平均值5020万升。进口量低于其13个月平均值每日1880万升，也远低于2025年11月创下的5210万升，后者为该期间最高水平。事实清单显示，消费量达到基准的93%，低于13个月平均值5100万升。消费量在2025年12月达到峰值，每日6370万升。管理局表示，国内炼油厂原油接收量增加，加上Dangote炼油厂汽油供应强劲，意味着10月消费的大部分汽油均在尼日利亚炼制。这降低了对进口的依赖，缓解了外汇压力，并提高了供应安全性。Dangote炼油厂每日生产汽油4851万升，产能利用率为每日65万桶产能的103.73%，较9月下降2.25个百分点。在汽油产量中，3189万升供应国内市场，另有2018万升、即产量的42%用于出口。该厂每日从库存中提取356万升汽油，期末汽油库存下降37%至2.299亿升。国内炼油厂原油接收量增长19%，达到每日73.6万桶。运往Dangote炼油厂的进口原油增长39%，达到每日11.84万桶，使本地原油占比从86.1%降至83.9%。Port Harcourt、Warri和Kaduna炼油厂没有生产。在模块化炼油厂中，Edo炼油厂的产能利用率为114.89%，WalterSmith为58.10%，Aradel为30.93%，OPAC为24.86%。Duport处于停产状态。模块化炼油厂每日供应68万升柴油，约占1400万升基准的4.9%。汽油库存覆盖期从9月的23.9天降至21.8天，比规定的30天门槛低8.2天。内陆油库可维持19.53天供应，近海船只上的库存可维持2.28天。LPG库存覆盖期较低，仅为14.8天。柴油库存覆盖期为43.9天，航空燃料为75.8天，两者均高于门槛。柴油供应量几乎翻倍，从每日870万升增长93%至每日1680万升。进口量从60万升增至610万升，国内供应量增长32%，达到每日1070万升。供应量超过1400万升的基准和1550万升的消费量。航空燃料供应量下降36%，降至每日210万升，低于每日280万升的消费量和300万升的基准。这是2026年7月以来的最低水平。Dangote炼油厂每日生产航空燃料2644万升，其中84%用于出口。管理局指出，库存覆盖期数据包括Dangote炼油厂199.7万升、拟出口的库存。液化石油气（LPG）供应量增长11%，达到每日5200吨，其中国内来源提供4800吨。消费量为5000吨。8个受监测州的汽油平均泵价上涨约3%，达到每升N1,416.75，处于N1,413.71至N1,447.00的指示价格区间低端。这8个州的实际最低价格均低于指示价格下限。液化石油气零售价从拉各斯每公斤N1,208到包奇每公斤N1,600。所有8个受监测州的最高零售价均超过指示价格。基准日Brent原油均价为每桶124.77美元，较9月上涨7%。汽油离岸成本下降8%，降至每公吨1,141.38美元。奈拉兑美元汇率上涨1%，至N1,338.54。2026年1月至10月，天然气批发供应总量平均为每日49.5亿立方英尺（bcf/d）。国内供应平均为每日2.04 bcf/d，占41.3%，向Nigeria LNG（NLNG）的供应平均为每日2.91 bcf/d，占58.7%。供应量在4月达到每日5.14 bcf/d的峰值，7月降至每日4.723 bcf/d。10月供应量为每日4.951 bcf/d，较9月增长2.7%，其中国内供应为每日2.113 bcf/d，NLNG为每日2.838 bcf/d。天然气发电用气量增长10%，达到每日0.571 bcf/d。LNG出口量增长7%，达到每日52,721公吨；通过西非天然气管道出口的管道天然气增长11%，达到每日0.149 bcf/d。47座天然气处理厂合计拥有每日161.87亿立方英尺的装机产能，每日处理84.01亿立方英尺，平均产能利用率为51.90%。7座主要设施中有4座的利用率超过80%，其中Gbaran Ubie以90.64%居首。3座设施的利用率低于50%，其中OB/OB为25.69%，Utorogu为29.41%。凝析油产量从1月的150.5万桶增至10月的220.9万桶。Obiafu-Obrikom-Oben（OB3）管道在10月达到100%完工。Ajaokuta-Kaduna-Kano管道在重新界定范围、纳入额外附属工程后，完成率为84.27%。Odidi-Warri扩建项目完成率为79.58%，Escravos-Odidi管道为34.75%，Escravos-Lagos压缩机项目为97.18%。管理局表示，稳定的接收量对维持供应稳定性至关重要，下一优先事项是重建库存缓冲。我们掌握独家优势。获取实时报道、独家爆料和深度视角，直接推送到您的手机。不要满足于过时新闻。加入LEADERSHIP https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.summary: Unlike in Korea, Lee said, real world experience, particularly experience working at startups, is highly valued in Silicon Valley. He believes this culture has made Silicon Valley a hotbed for innovation and encouraged more young Americans to pursue their own entrepreneurial ventures. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.summary_zh: 李表示，与韩国不同，硅谷非常看重实践经验，尤其是在初创企业工作的经验。他认为，这种文化使硅谷成为创新热土，并鼓励更多年轻美国人投身自己的创业事业。7月，Philyron 获得了 Andreessen Horowitz 的50万美元投资。该机构又称 a16z，是硅谷最强大、最有声望的风险投资机构之一。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.body: Lee Seung-heon, also known as Heon Lee in the U.S., has chosen a path that many other Koreans would consider too risky to take. He dropped out of college to work full time at Philyron, a San Francisco-based maritime technology startup he co-founded in June this year. “Korean students and their parents feel pressure when it comes to choosing a career over a college education. But in Silicon Valley, I’ve met plenty of young Americans who dropped out of prestigious universities to start their own businesses,” he told The Korea Times. “There is certainly a cultural difference between the two countries when it comes to college education. I concluded that starting my own business was the right decision and that spending three more years in college would be meaningless because schools don’t teach you how to start a business and keep it growing.” Lee, 24, initially studied political science at Boston University. After completing his freshman year, he transferred to the University of Michigan at Ann Arbor before returning to Korea to fulfill his mandatory military service. Initially, he planned to return to school to study computer science and political science, but he changed his mind. Lee saw enormous opportunities in two simultaneous booms: the rapid growth of artificial intelligence (AI) and the thriving U.S. shipbuilding industry. He decided to seize the opportunities created by these emerging trends. In the U.S., particularly in the information technology industry, dropping out of college is not considered taboo. This may be partly because several tech billionaires left university to build their businesses. Bill Gates dropped out of Harvard University and co-founded Microsoft with Paul Allen. Steve Jobs dropped out of Reed College and co-founded Apple. Mark Zuckerberg, Michael Dell and Dustin Moskovitz are among other prominent college dropouts. Unlike in Korea, Lee said, real world experience, particularly experience working at startups, is highly valued in Silicon Valley. He believes this culture has made Silicon Valley a hotbed for innovation and encouraged more young Americans to pursue their own entrepreneurial ventures. Philyron develops AI-driven thermal and acoustic sensors that can be installed on ship hulls to provide operators with critical information about the condition and lifecycle of onboard devices and equipment, including when they need to be repaired or replaced. The technology makes vessel maintenance more predictable and helps operators manage their fleets more efficiently. After San Francisco Bay Ferry became Philyron’s first customer, several other U.S. government agencies also adopted the startup’s sensors. The National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration is among the company’s government partners. “Like other Korean parents, my parents initially didn't approve of my decision to leave college. But they have changed their minds after seeing the progress my business has made. Now they encourage me to keep doing whatever I want,” he said. In July, Philyron secured $500,000 in investment from Andreessen Horowitz, also known as a16z, one of the most powerful and prestigious Silicon Valley venture capital firms. Since then, Lee’s maritime startup has continued to expand its partnerships, primarily with U.S. government agencies. “At Philyron, we are a small team of four, including myself. We aim to reach the $1 million revenue milestone next year,” he said. “Currently, most of our clients are U.S. government agencies. We’d like to sell our products to defense operators.” Lee wears two hats at Philyron, keeping him busy. Like the company's other engineers, he works on software development. At the same time, he actively reaches out to potential clients to market the company's products. He said his network of industry insiders had played an important role in helping him secure contracts with U.S. government agencies. Among those who have supported him is Kevin Humphreys, a vice president at Saronic Technologies. “Mr. Humphreys saw opportunities in our startup and invested in it. Currently, we provide our sensors mainly to vessels, but they can also be used in other types of vehicles, such as trucks and aircraft. Mr. Humphreys recognized this potential,” he said. As a co-founder, Lee said his ambition was relatively modest: to keep growing the business and build a sustainable company. “All of our staff members are smart and talented. They are all students at Stanford, MIT and Berkeley, and they work part time,” he said. “I’d like to have them join us full time. To make that happen, I need to prove that this company is financially viable enough to convince them to put their college education on hold and work here full time.”
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.title_zh: 一名24岁韩国人的硅谷豪赌获得a16z支持，迎来回报
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.body_zh:
李承勋（在美国也被称为Heon Lee）选择了许多其他韩国人认为风险太大的道路。他从大学退学，全职供职于Philyron——这是一家总部位于旧金山的海事科技初创企业，由他于今年6月共同创办。

他告诉《韩国时报》：“韩国学生及其父母在选择职业生涯还是大学教育时都会感到压力。但在硅谷，我遇到了许多放弃名校大学学业、创办自己企业的年轻美国人。”

“在大学教育方面，两国之间确实存在文化差异。我得出结论，创办自己的企业才是正确的决定；再花三年读大学毫无意义，因为学校不会教你如何创办并持续发展企业。”

现年24岁的李最初在波士顿大学学习政治学。大一结束后，他转入密歇根大学安娜堡分校，随后返回韩国服义务兵役。起初，他打算复学并学习计算机科学和政治学，但后来改变了主意。李看到两股同时兴起的热潮蕴含着巨大机遇：人工智能（AI）的快速增长，以及美国造船业的蓬勃发展。他决定抓住这些新兴趋势带来的机会。

在美国，尤其是在信息技术行业，从大学退学并不被视为禁忌。这或许是因为有多位科技亿万富翁离开大学创业。比尔·盖茨从哈佛大学退学，与保罗·艾伦共同创办了微软。史蒂夫·乔布斯从里德学院退学，共同创办了苹果公司。马克·扎克伯格、迈克尔·戴尔和达斯廷·莫斯科维茨也是其他著名的大学退学者。李说，与韩国不同，在硅谷，真实-world经验，尤其是初创企业工作经验，受到高度重视。他认为，这种文化使硅谷成为创新熱土，也鼓励更多年轻美国人 pursue自己的创业事业。

Philyron研发由人工智能驱动的热学与声学传感器，可安装在船体上，为运营方提供有关船上设备和器材状况及生命周期的重要信息，包括何时需要维修或更换。这项技术使船舶维护更具可预测性，帮助运营方更高效地管理船队。

在San Francisco Bay Ferry成为Philyron的首位客户后，美国多家政府机构也开始采用这家初创企业的传感器。美国国家海洋和大气管理局是该公司的政府合作伙伴之一。

他说：“和其他韩国父母一样，我父母最初不赞成我离开大学的决定。但看到我的企业取得进展后，他们改变了看法。现在，他们鼓励我继续做任何想做的事。”

7月，Philyron获得了Andreessen Horowitz（又称a16z）的50万美元投资。该公司是硅谷最强劲、最有声望的风险投资机构之一。此后，李这家海事初创企业继续扩大合作范围，主要合作方是美国政府机构。

他说：“在Philyron，我们是一个四人小团队，包括我本人在内。我们的目标是明年达到100万美元的营收里程碑。目前，大多数客户是美国政府机构。我们希望向国防领域的运营方销售产品。”

在Philyron，李身兼两职，忙个不停。与公司的其他工程师一样，他负责软件开发。与此同时，他积极联系潜在客户，推广公司的产品。他说，自己在业内人士中建立的人脉网络，在帮助他拿下美国政府机构合同方面发挥了重要作用。

支持他的人士中包括Saronic Technologies副总裁Kevin Humphreys。他说：“Humphreys先生看到了我们初创企业的机遇，并为其投资。目前，我们主要向船舶提供传感器，但传感器也可用于其他类型的交通工具，如卡车和飞机。Humphreys先生认识到了这种潜力。”

作为共同创始人，李说自己的抱负相对 modest：继续推动业务增长，打造一家可持续经营的企业。

他说：“我们所有员工都很聪明、很有才华。他们都是斯坦福大学、MIT和伯克利的学生，目前兼职工作。我希望他们全职加入我们。要实现这一点，我需要证明这家公司在财务上足够稳健，足以说服他们暂缓大学学业，到这里全职工作。”

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/why-.summary: The Minister of Defence, General Christopher Gwabin Musa (rtd), has reaffirmed the Federal Government’s commitment to a comprehensive, whole-of-government strategy to combat terrorism, while seeking stronger security cooperation with the European Union (EU). https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/why-.summary_zh: 国防部长Christopher Gwabin Musa将军（退役）重申，联邦政府致力于采取全面且政府各部委协同的战略打击恐怖主义，同时寻求与欧洲联盟（EU）加强安全合作。Musa在比利时布鲁塞尔欧洲议会举行的第三届舒曼安全与防务论坛上透露了上述立场，并代表尼日利亚出席活动。
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/why-.body: The Minister of Defence, General Christopher Gwabin Musa (rtd), has reaffirmed the Federal Government’s commitment to a comprehensive, whole-of-government strategy to combat terrorism, while seeking stronger security cooperation with the European Union (EU). Musa made this known at the third edition of the Schuman Security and Defence Forum held at the European Parliament in Brussels, Belgium, where he represented Nigeria. A statement issued by the Special Adviser on Media to the Minister, Leah Katung-Babatunde quoted the minister saying Nigeria was shifting from a predominantly military approach to a coordinated counterterrorism strategy involving intelligence gathering, law enforcement, community engagement and socio-economic interventions. He explained that terrorism remained a complex security challenge fuelled by economic vulnerabilities, porous borders, local grievances and transnational organised crime. The minister said the strategy, guided by Nigeria’s National Counter Terrorism Strategy (NACTEST), reflected the administration’s determination to address both the immediate threats posed by terrorist groups and the underlying factors sustaining insecurity. Addressing the growing use of emerging technologies by violent extremist groups, Musa highlighted Nigeria’s efforts to counter the illicit deployment of drones, digital communication devices and satellite technologies. He said the Armed Forces of Nigeria were deploying intelligence-led operations, advanced surveillance systems, unmanned aerial platforms and military artificial intelligence to weaken terrorist networks. He particularly disclosed that troops of Operation Hadin Kai intercepted more than 400 Starlink communication devices linked to terrorist networks in the North-East in May 2026. Musa also highlighted the Ministry of Defence’s efforts to promote indigenous defence innovation through research and partnerships with the private sector. He called for stronger collaboration with the European Union in counter-drone technologies, digital forensics and satellite intelligence to enhance Nigeria’s capacity to respond to evolving security threats. On the financial networks sustaining terrorism, the minister stressed the need to dismantle criminal economies, including kidnapping for ransom, illegal mining, cattle rustling and illicit arms trafficking. He said the Nigerian Financial Intelligence Unit (NFIU), National Counter Terrorism Centre (NCTC) and other security agencies were working together to trace illicit financial flows, prosecute criminal facilitators and strengthen border security to disrupt terrorist supply chains. He also emphasised that the Armed Forces remained committed to operating within the framework of national laws and international humanitarian law, with priority given to civilian protection and due process in the prosecution of suspects. According to him, Nigeria also recognises the importance of rehabilitation and reintegration programmes for eligible former combatants through initiatives such as Operation Safe Corridor. The Schuman Security and Defence Forum provides a platform for high-level discussions on international peace, security and defence among defence ministers of partner countries, European Union member states, representatives of international organisations and leading think tanks. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/why-.body_zh: 国防部长兼退役上将Christopher Gwabin Musa再次强调，联邦政府致力于采取全面、全政府协同战略打击恐怖主义，同时寻求与欧洲联盟（EU）加强安全合作。Musa在比利时布鲁塞尔欧洲议会举行的第三届舒曼安全与防务论坛上宣布了上述表态，并代表尼日利亚发言。部长媒体特别顾问Leah Katung-Babatunde发表的一份声明援引部长的话说，尼日利亚正从主要依靠军事手段转向协调一致的反恐战略，综合开展情报收集、执法、社区参与和社会经济干预。他解释道，恐怖主义仍是一项复杂的安全挑战，其推动因素包括经济脆弱性、边境管控松散、地方矛盾和跨国有组织犯罪。部长表示，这项以尼日利亚国家反恐战略（NACTEST）为指导的战略，体现了政府决心既应对恐怖组织造成的直接威胁，也处理持续滋生不安全局势的根本因素。针对暴力极端组织日益频繁地使用新兴技术，Musa强调尼日利亚正在努力打击无人机、数字通信设备和卫星技术的非法使用。他说，尼日利亚武装部队正部署以情报为引导的行动、先进监视系统、无人平台和军事人工智能，以削弱恐怖组织网络。他特别披露，2026年5月，Hadin Kai行动部队在东北部截获了400多台与恐怖组织网络有关的Starlink通信设备。Musa还强调，国防部正通过研究以及与私营部门建立伙伴关系，推动本土国防创新。他呼吁与欧洲联盟在反无人机技术、数字取证和卫星情报方面加强协作，以提升尼日利亚应对不断演变的安全威胁的能力。谈及为恐怖主义提供支撑的金融网络，部长强调必须摧毁犯罪经济，包括绑架勒索、非法采矿、盗掠牲畜和非法武器贩运。他说，尼日利亚金融情报单位（NFIU）、国家反恐中心（NCTC）及其他安全机构正协同追查非法资金流、起诉犯罪协助者并加强边境安全，以切断恐怖组织的供应链。他还强调，尼日利亚武装部队仍致力于在本国法律和国际人道法框架内行动，并优先保护平民，在起诉嫌疑人时保障正当程序。他表示，尼日利亚也认识到，通过“安全走廊行动”等举措，为符合条件的原战斗人员实施康复和重新融入计划具有重要意义。舒曼安全与防务论坛为合作伙伴国家国防部长、欧洲联盟成员国、国际组织代表和主要智库就国际和平、安全与防务问题进行高级别讨论提供平台。本文所载评论不代表Vanguard报纸及其任何员工的观点。

Unlock these with Subscription India's position on the Indus Waters Treaty (IWT) is "very clear" and there has been "absolutely no change" in it, the Ministry of External Affairs said on Friday (November 20, 2026), amid a visit by Pakistan Minister Musadik Malik to attend the SCO Civilisational Dialogue Forum in Delhi. Mr. Malik, who arrived here in the early hours of Friday (November 20, 2026), attended the opening day of the three-day forum in the evening. The event, being hosted by India at the historic Purana Quila, was inaugurated by Prime Minister Narendra Modi. India had announced on October 28 that invitations had been extended to all SCO members, including Pakistan, in keeping with established practice. It was perhaps the first time New Delhi had invited a Pakistani minister to attend an event in India since the May 7-10 military hostilities last year following Operation Sindoor. Pakistan had announced on November 14 that its Climate Change Minister Malik would participate in the forum. At his bi-weekly media briefing, Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal was asked how New Delhi viewed Mr. Malik's participation in the India-hosted forum, given that he does not hold the culture portfolio and had reportedly made comments on the IWT. "As far as IWT is concerned, we have made our position very clear, and that is where it remains. There is absolutely no change," Mr. Jaiswal said. India suspended the treaty in 2025 as one of the punitive measures against Pakistan after the April 22 Pahalgam terror attack last year that claimed 26 lives. Mr. Malik's participation in the forum is being seen by some experts as an opportunity in a multilateral framework that may help improve ties between the two neighbours. Interacting with reporters on the sidelines of the forum, Mr. Malik, when asked about the role of culture in fostering better ties between India and Pakistan, said, "Culture has a very key role to play". Hours before the inauguration, the MEA on Friday (November 20, 2026) said the forum was a "multilateral event within the SCO framework", for which invitations had been extended to all members of the grouping, including Pakistan. "India is hosting the 1st SCO Civilisation Dialogue on 20-22 November 2026, in New Delhi. This is a multilateral event within the SCO framework, for which invitations have been extended to all members of the SCO, including Pakistan," the MEA said in a post on X. "Observers and Dialogue Partners of the SCO have also been invited to attend the Dialogue, which will be inaugurated this evening by the Hon’ble Prime Minister," it said. The event is being hosted by the Ministry of Culture and the MEA. The SCO was founded at a summit in Shanghai in 2001 by the presidents of Russia, China, the Kyrgyz Republic, Kazakhstan, Tajikistan and Uzbekistan. 印度外交部周五（2026年11月20日）表示，印度对《印度河水条约》（IWT）的立场“非常明确”，并且“绝对没有任何改变”。此前，巴基斯坦部长穆萨迪克·马利克到访新德里，参加上海合作组织文明对话论坛。马利克先生于周五（2026年11月20日）凌晨抵达印度，当晚出席了这为期三天论坛的开幕日活动。此次活动在历史悠久的浦拉纳堡由印度主办，总理纳伦德拉·莫迪主持开幕。

印度曾于10月28日宣布，按照既定惯例，已向包括巴基斯坦在内的所有上海合作组织成员国发出邀请。这或许是去年5月7日至10日“辛杜尔行动”引发军事冲突后，新德里首次邀请巴基斯坦部长赴印度参加活动。

巴基斯坦于11月14日宣布，其气候变化部长马利克将参加该论坛。在每两周举行一次的媒体吹风会上，印度外交部（MEA）发言人兰迪尔·贾伊瓦尔被问及，鉴于马利克先生并不主管文化事务，且据报道曾就《印度河水条约》发表评论，新德里如何看待他参加印度主办的论坛。

贾伊瓦尔先生说：“就《印度河水条约》而言，我们已经非常明确地表明了立场，而且立场依然如旧。绝对没有任何改变。”

去年4月22日帕哈尔加姆恐怖袭击造成26人死亡后，印度于2025年暂停履行该条约，以此作为针对巴基斯坦的惩罚措施之一。

一些专家认为，马利克先生参加论坛提供了一个多边框架下的机会，可能有助于改善这两个邻国之间的关系。在论坛场边与记者互动时，当被问及文化在促进印巴关系方面发挥的作用时，马利克先生说：“文化发挥着非常关键的作用。”

开幕前数小时，印度外交部于周五（2026年11月20日）表示，该论坛是“上海合作组织框架内的一场多边活动”，已向包括巴基斯坦在内的该组织所有成员发出邀请。

印度外交部在X平台上发帖称：“印度于2026年11月20日至22日在新德里举办首届上海合作组织文明对话。这是上海合作组织框架内的一场多边活动，我们已向包括巴基斯坦在内的上海合作组织全体成员发出邀请。”

该帖还说：“上海合作组织的观察员国和对话伙伴也受邀出席对话活动，活动将于今晚由尊敬的总理主持开幕。”

本次活动由印度文化部和外交部共同主办。

上海合作组织于2001年在上海举行的一次峰会上成立，创始成员为俄罗斯、中国、吉尔吉斯共和国、哈萨克斯坦、塔吉克斯坦和乌兹别克斯坦的总统。印度和巴基斯坦于2017年成为该组织的永久成员。

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/21/c.body: Nigeria’s push to expand gas-powered mobility is gaining momentum as the federal government’s removal of VAT and import duties on CNG vehicles, conversion kits, and related equipment begins to reshape the economics of transportation. The incentives could lower entry costs for motorists and fleet operators while creating fresh opportunities across the automotive value chain, but their long-term impact will depend on infrastructure, financing, and reliable gas supply. For Nigeria’s transport operators, the cost of fuel is only one part of the equation. The price of acquiring a vehicle, converting it to an alternative fuel, sourcing spare parts, maintaining the powertrain, and keeping vehicles on the road all determine whether a cheaper fuel ultimately translates into cheaper mobility. This is where the federal government’s decision to remove Value Added Tax (VAT) and import duties on Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG), Compressed Natural Gas (CNG) and related equipment becomes significant beyond the energy sector. Although the incentives were introduced to make gas more accessible and encourage investment, their implications are increasingly being felt in transportation, particularly as Nigeria seeks to expand CNG-powered mobility. For an industry grappling with high operating costs, the removal of taxes on CNG equipment and conversion components could lower some of the financial barriers facing motorists and commercial transport operators seeking alternatives to petrol and diesel. The journey towards the tax exemptions gained momentum in 2023 when the Nigeria Liquefied and Compressed Gases Association (NLCGA) took its concerns to the presidency through an advocacy engagement with Olu Verheijen, Special Adviser to President Bola Ahmed Tinubu on Energy. The association highlighted the pressure created by VAT and import duties on LPG, CNG and the equipment required to store, transport, distribute and use gas. For the mobility sector, the issue was particularly important because CNG adoption depends on more than the availability of natural gas. It requires conversion kits, cylinders, valves, dispensers, compressors, trucks, safety equipment and other components. When these items attract additional taxes and duties, the cost is eventually reflected in the investment required by operators and, potentially, the price paid by vehicle owners. The NLCGA subsequently submitted detailed proposals outlining areas requiring government intervention and also called for stronger coordination among government agencies responsible for policies affecting the gas industry. The engagements that followed with the Office of the Special Adviser and the Federal Ministry of Finance eventually produced policy measures aimed at reducing some of those costs. On November 28, 2023, the government provided for zero import duty and VAT on LPG and a range of essential equipment. The relief covered items such as gas cylinders, cascades, leak detectors, pipes, valves, dispensers, generators and LPG trucks. A subsequent directive in December extended similar treatment to CNG equipment, strengthening the fiscal framework around the emerging gas-for-mobility market. The economics of CNG conversion are relatively straightforward. A vehicle owner considering conversion must weigh the initial cost against the expected savings from using CNG. If the equipment, installation, and related components become more expensive because of taxes and import duties, the period required to recover the investment becomes longer. That can discourage private motorists and commercial operators from making the switch. The removal of VAT and import duties, therefore, has the potential to reduce the upfront cost of conversion and improve the business case for CNG. For a commercial bus, taxi, haulage truck or delivery vehicle that operates for several hours every day, fuel represents a significant proportion of operating expenditure. An alternative fuel becomes attractive when the cost of conversion and the availability of refueling infrastructure are also manageable. The fiscal incentives seek to address part of that equation. They also have implications for companies importing fully CNG-powered vehicles. By removing applicable import duty and VAT on qualifying vehicles and equipment, the government is creating an additional incentive for businesses to consider gas-powered fleets. For Ladi Falola, President of the Nigeria Liquefied and Compressed Gases Association (NLCGA), the tax incentives should be viewed as part of a broader effort to build a viable gas market rather than simply as measures for reducing government revenue. Falola said reducing the fiscal burden on CNG equipment could encourage investment and make the transition to gas-powered transportation more attractive to motorists and fleet operators. He stressed, however, that tax relief alone would not deliver the desired transformation. The NLCGA President also sees the development of the CNG market as an opportunity to deepen activity across the domestic automotive and gas value chains, particularly through local assembly, technical services and equipment supply. Nigeria’s CNG transition has increasingly moved from policy announcements to fleet-level decisions. Large commercial operators are exploring the technology as they seek to contain fuel expenditure and reduce exposure to petrol and diesel price volatility. Dangote Cement, for instance, has announced plans to transition substantial portions of its fleet to CNG-powered vehicles. For businesses operating hundreds or thousands of vehicles, the economics can be compelling. A reduction in fuel expenditure multiplied across a large fleet can produce significant savings. But those savings can only materialise if vehicles have reliable access to CNG. This makes the tax exemptions part of a much larger mobility equation. Lower conversion costs without adequate refuelling stations could leave vehicles underutilised. More filling stations without sufficient demand could undermine investment returns. And cheaper conversion equipment without adequate standards and trained technicians could create safety and reliability concerns. The policy, therefore, needs to be viewed as one component of a developing CNG ecosystem rather than a standalone solution. Nigeria’s transition to CNG is happening against the backdrop of a transport sector already under pressure from high vehicle operating costs, inadequate infrastructure and expensive maintenance. The emergence of CNG creates an opportunity to reshape some of those economics, but it also exposes infrastructure gaps. CNG vehicles require appropriate compression, storage and dispensing infrastructure. Conversion centres need trained personnel and equipment. Spare parts must be readily available. Vehicle owners also need confidence that they can refuel without making significant detours or facing prolonged queues. This is where the removal of taxes on equipment could have a wider impact. Lower import costs can make it easier for investors to acquire the equipment needed to establish and expand CNG infrastructure. As more operators enter the market, competition could improve availability and service delivery. The objective should, therefore, go beyond getting more vehicles converted. It should be to build a functioning market around those vehicles. The CNG policy also fits into the Government’s broader attempt to diversify Nigeria’s transportation fuel mix. For decades, petrol and diesel have dominated road transportation, leaving motorists highly exposed to changes in fuel prices and supply conditions. CNG offers another option, particularly for high-mileage commercial vehicles. But the transition cannot be sustained by tax exemptions alone. The industry still needs consistent policies, investment in refuelling infrastructure, reliable gas supply, standards enforcement,nt and affordable financing for vehicle conversion. Even where the cost of conversion falls, many commercial drivers and small fleet operators may still struggle to raise the capital required to convert their vehicles. Access to credit, leasing arrangements and fleet financing could therefore determine how widely the technology spreads beyond large corporations. The development of local manufacturing and assembly of conversion equipment could also become increasingly important. If Nigeria eventually produces a larger proportion of the equipment required by the CNG market locally, the country could reduce its dependence on imported components while creating opportunities for manufacturers, technicians and other businesses within the automotive value chain. The implications of the tax policy extend beyond motorists. A growing CNG market creates opportunities for vehicle dealers, conversion centres, component suppliers, mechanics, engineers, transport companies and energy businesses. As more vehicles move towards gas, demand will grow for specialised maintenance and technical services. This could produce a new layer of expertise within Nigeria’s automotive industry. Workshops that traditionally focused on petrol and diesel vehicles will increasingly need technicians trained to work safely on CNG systems. Parts distributors will need to understand the requirements of gas-powered vehicles. Insurance and inspection businesses will also have to adapt to a changing vehicle population. In this sense, the CNG transition could become an industrial policy as much as a fuel policy. The more equipment and services that can be produced and supplied locally, the greater the potential economic benefit beyond fuel savings. The NLCGA has set an ambition of increasing annual LPG consumption to five million metric tons by 2030 while supporting wider adoption of gas in transportation. The government’s tax exemptions provide an important starting point by reducing some of the costs associated with importing gas and mobility equipment. But their ultimate success will depend on whether the benefits translate into lower acquisition costs, more investment and greater consumer access. For investors, the question is whether Nigeria can create a market large and stable enough to justify investment in infrastructure and equipment. For government, the challenge is ensuring that fiscal incentives are supported by the policies and infrastructure needed to make the transition work. What began as an industry advocacy effort in 2023 has evolved into a policy intervention with implications for Nigeria’s automotive and transport sectors. The removal of VAT and import duties does not, by itself, guarantee cheaper mobility. Fuel prices, exchange rates, gas availability, infrastructure, vehicle costs, and maintenance will continue to influence the economics of transportation. But by removing some of the fiscal costs attached to CNG equipment and vehicles, the Government has lowered one barrier to adoption. If investment in refueling infrastructure keeps pace with vehicle conversions, technical standards remain strong, financing becomes accessible and supply remains reliable, CNG could move beyond being an alternative fuel promoted through government policy to become a commercially viable component of Nigeria’s transport system. For a country searching for ways to reduce the cost of mobility while developing its domestic gas resources, that distinction matters. The real measure of the VAT and import-duty exemptions, therefore, will not be the taxes the government has removed. It will be the vehicles that are converted, the filling stations that are built, the businesses that emerge and, ultimately, the extent to which Nigerian motorists can move people and goods at lower and more predictable cost. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/21/c.title_zh: 压缩天然气税收减免：为尼日利亚交通运输业注入动力
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/21/c.body_zh:
尼日利亚推动扩大燃气交通的动力日益增强。随着联邦政府取消压缩天然气汽车、改装套件及相关设备的增值税和进口关税，交通运输的经济格局开始发生改变。这些激励措施可降低驾车者和车队运营商的入门成本，同时为汽车产业链带来新的机遇，但其长期影响将取决于基础设施、融资以及可靠的天然气供应。

对尼日利亚运输运营商而言，燃油成本只是整个经济账本的一部分。购置车辆、将其改装为使用替代燃料、采购备件、维护动力系统以及确保车辆持续运行的成本，共同决定廉价燃料最终能否转化为更低的出行成本。正是在这一背景下，联邦政府决定取消液化石油气（LPG）、压缩天然气（CNG）及相关设备的增值税和进口关税，其意义超出了能源行业本身。尽管这些激励措施旨在提高燃气可获得性并鼓励投资，但随着尼日利亚寻求扩大压缩天然气动力交通，其影响正日益在交通运输领域显现。

对于一个承受高运营成本压力的行业，取消压缩天然气设备和改装部件的税收可降低部分财务门槛，帮助驾车者和商业运输运营商寻找汽油和柴油的替代方案。争取税收减免的进程在2023年获得推动。当时，尼日利亚液化气和压缩气体协会（NLCGA）通过与总统博拉·艾哈迈德·蒂努布的能源特别顾问奥卢·弗尔海恩开展倡导活动，将相关担忧提交给总统府。该协会强调，增值税和进口关税对LPG、CNG以及储存、运输、分配和使用燃气所需设备造成了压力。

对交通出行领域而言，这一问题尤为重要，因为采用压缩天然气不仅取决于天然气供应，还依赖改装套件、气瓶、阀门、加油设备、压缩机、卡车、安全设备及其他部件。如果这些物品被额外征收税款和关税，成本最终会反映在运营商所需投资中，并可能转嫁给车主。NLCGA随后提交了详细建议，列出需要政府干预的领域，同时呼吁负责影响燃气行业政策的各政府机构加强协调。此后，与特别顾问办公室和联邦财政部的沟通促成了一系列旨在降低部分成本的政策措施。

2023年11月28日，政府规定LPG及一系列必要设备的进口关税和增值税均为零。减免范围包括燃气瓶、级联式储气装置、泄漏探测器、管道、阀门、加油设备、发电机和LPG运输车等。12月发布的另一项指令将类似待遇扩大至CNG设备，为新兴的燃气出行市场巩固了财政政策框架。

压缩天然气改装的经济账目相对简单。考虑改装车辆的车主必须将初始成本与使用CNG预计节省的费用进行权衡。如果设备、安装和相关部件因税收及进口关税而变得更昂贵，投资回收期就会延长。这可能打消私人车主和商业运营商转用压缩天然气的意愿。因此，取消增值税和进口关税有望降低改装的前期成本，并改善CNG的商业可行性。

对于每天运行数小时的商用客车、出租车、货运卡车或配送车辆，燃油占运营支出的很大比例。当改装成本可控且加气基础设施供应充足时，替代燃料便具有吸引力。财政激励措施旨在解决这一经济账目中的一部分问题。这些措施也对进口全CNG动力车辆的企业产生影响。通过取消符合条件的车辆和设备所适用的进口关税及增值税，政府为企业考虑采用燃气车队提供了额外激励。

尼日利亚液化气和压缩气体协会（NLCGA）会长拉迪·法洛拉认为，这些税收激励应被视为建设可持续燃气市场这一更广泛努力的一部分，而不应仅仅被看作减少政府收入的措施。法洛拉表示，降低CNG设备的财政负担可鼓励投资，并使驾车者和车队运营商更愿意转向燃气运输。不过，他强调，仅靠税收减免无法带来预期中的转型。NLCGA会长还认为，CNG市场的发展为深化国内汽车和燃气产业链活动提供了机会，尤其是通过本地组装、技术服务和设备供应来实现。

尼日利亚向CNG的转型正日益从政策宣布落实到车队层面的实际决策。大型商业运营商正在探索这项技术，以控制燃油支出并降低对汽油和柴油价格波动的暴露。例如， Dangote Cement已宣布计划将车队中相当一部分车辆转为CNG动力。对于运营数百或数千辆车的企业而言，其经济收益可能十分可观。车队规模越大，燃油支出的降幅乘以车辆数量，节省金额也就越可观。但只有车辆能够稳定获得CNG供应，这些节省才能实现。因此，税收减免只是整个出行经济体系中更大一环。

如果降低改装成本却没有充足的加气站，车辆利用率可能仍然偏低。如果加气站增加而需求不足，投资回报又可能受损。如果改装设备价格下降，却缺乏完善标准和训练有素的技术人员，则可能引发安全和可靠性问题。因此，这项政策应被视为正在形成的CNG生态系统的一个组成部分，而非一项独立解决方案。

尼日利亚正在向CNG转型，而其交通行业同时面临车辆运营成本高、基础设施不足和维护费用昂贵等压力。CNG的兴起为重塑部分成本结构提供了机会，但也暴露了基础设施缺口。CNG车辆需要配套的压缩、储存和加气基础设施，改装中心需要训练有素的人员和设备，备件必须能够随时供应。车主还需要相信，他们无需大幅绕行或长时间排队就能完成加油。正是在这一背景下，取消设备税收可能产生更广泛影响。较低的进口成本可让投资者更容易购建设立和扩建CNG基础设施所需的设备。随着更多运营商进入市场，竞争或许能改善设备供应和服务质量。因此，政策目标不应止于让更多车辆完成改装，而应着眼于围绕这些车辆建立运转良好的市场。

CNG政策也是政府推动尼日利亚交通燃料结构多元化总体努力的一部分。数十年来，汽油和柴油一直主导道路运输，使驾车者高度暴露于燃料价格和供应条件的变化之下。CNG提供了另一种选择，尤其适合高里程商业车辆。但这一转型不能仅靠税收减免维系。行业仍需要稳定的政策、对加气基础设施的投资、可靠的燃气供应、标准执行，以及可负担的车辆改装融资。即使改装成本下降，许多商业驾驶者和小型车队运营商仍可能难以筹集改装车辆所需资本。因此，信贷获取、租赁安排和车队融资可能决定这项技术在大型企业之外得到多广泛的应用。

本地制造和组装改装设备也将变得愈发重要。如果尼日利亚最终能够在本地生产CNG市场所需设备中更大比例的产品，该国便可降低对进口零部件的依赖，同时为汽车产业链内的制造商、技术人员及其他企业创造机会。税收政策的影响并不限于驾车者。不断增长的CNG市场将为车辆经销商、改装中心、零部件供应商、机械师、工程师、运输公司和能源企业带来机会。随着更多车辆转向燃气燃料，对专业维护和技术服务的需求将增长。这可能在尼日利亚汽车行业形成新的专业能力层。传统上专注于汽油和柴油车辆的车间，将越来越需要接受过培训、能够安全检修CNG系统的技术人员。零部件经销商需要了解燃气动力车辆的要求，保险和车辆检验企业也必须适应不断变化的车辆构成。从这个意义上说，CNG转型不仅可以是一项燃料政策，也可以成为一项产业政策。本地能够生产和供应的设备与服务越多，其带来的经济收益就越有可能超越燃油节省本身。

NLCGA提出到2030年将LPG年消费量提高到500万吨的目标，同时支持燃气在交通运输领域得到更广泛采用。政府的税收减免通过降低进口燃气和出行设备的相关成本，提供了重要起点。但其最终成效将取决于这些利益能否转化为更低的购置成本、更多投资和更广的消费者可及性。对投资者而言，问题是尼日利亚能否创建一个足够庞大且稳定的市场，以证明对基础设施和设备投资的合理性。对政府而言，挑战在于确保财政激励措施有配套政策和基础设施支撑，使转型切实可行。

这场始于2023年的行业倡导行动已经演变为一项政策干预，对尼日利亚汽车和运输行业均产生深远影响。取消增值税和进口关税本身并不能保证出行成本下降。燃料价格、汇率、燃气供应、基础设施、车辆成本和维护费用仍会继续影响交通运输的经济格局。但通过取消CNG设备和车辆附带的部分财政成本，政府降低了采用这项技术的一道障碍。如果对加气基础设施的投资与车辆改装同步推进，技术标准保持严格，融资渠道更加便利，供应保持可靠，CNG就可能不再只是政府推动的替代燃料，而有望成为尼日利亚交通体系中具备商业可行性的组成部分。对于一个寻求降低出行成本、同时开发本国天然气资源的国家而言，这一区别至关重要。

因此，衡量增值税和进口关税减免成效的真正标准，并非政府免除了多少税款，而是有多少车辆完成改装、建成了多少加气站、涌现了多少企业，以及最终尼日利亚驾车者能够在多大程度上以更低且更可预测的成本运送人员与货物。
